description: Convert the manual, non-gating live-host smoke checklist for the published sandbox image into a repeatable instrument: an image-only compose driver, a flavor switch on the existing boot smoke, a deployment guard that pulls and boots the published GHCR image and asserts resource and internal provisioning, a tier-A wiring probe, and a post-release CI workflow.

userStories.title: Image-only compose driver
userStories.description: As the deployment guard, I want a compose driver for the image-only flavor so that the existing BOOT_SMOKE_COMPOSE seam can boot a published image without the local bind-mount stack.
acceptanceCriteria: .oh/scripts/deployment-compose.sh exists, is executable, and forwards its argv to `docker compose -f .devcontainer/docker-compose.image-only.yml`

It reads no repository dotenv: it passes no --env-file and does not source .env or .devcontainer/.env, so the rendered OH_SANDBOX_IMAGE / OH_PULL_POLICY / SANDBOX_NAME of the local flavor cannot leak in

It exports DOCKER_CONFIG pointing at an empty scratch directory it creates, overridable by OH_DEPLOY_DOCKER_CONFIG, so an unexecutable ambient credsStore cannot fail an anonymous pull of a public image
`bash .oh/scripts/deployment-compose.sh config --quiet` exits 0 with OH_SANDBOX_IMAGE and SANDBOX_NAME set
shellcheck -S warning passes on the file
It adds no compose file and no compose `environment:` key, so .oh/evals/probes/compose-env-boundary.sh still passes
userStories.notes: shellcheck clean; `deployment-compose.sh config --quiet` exits 0 and resolves name/container/image from the exported env with no dotenv read; compose-env-boundary probe still PASS.

userStories.title: BOOT_SMOKE_FLAVOR switch on the boot smoke
userStories.description: As the deployment guard, I want sandbox-boot-smoke.sh to accept an image-only flavor so that its provisioning oracle is reused rather than re-derived, without asserting a bind ownership contract that does not exist on that flavor.
acceptanceCriteria: BOOT_SMOKE_FLAVOR defaults to `bind`; the default path still calls verify_bind_ownership
BOOT_SMOKE_FLAVOR=image-only skips verify_bind_ownership and nothing else; verify_default_catalog runs unchanged for both `harness` and `tool`
The skip is keyed on the flavor variable, never on detecting an absent checkout
An unrecognised BOOT_SMOKE_FLAVOR value exits non-zero with a message naming the accepted values, rather than silently defaulting
The success line names the flavor that ran
This is the only edit to the file; verify_default_catalog and verify_bind_ownership are not moved, copied, or rewritten
shellcheck -S warning passes on the file
userStories.notes: BOOT_SMOKE_FLAVOR=bogus exits 2 naming the accepted values; the live image-only run printed "sandbox boot smoke ok [image-only] ... no bind-ownership check on this flavor"; verify_default_catalog reused byte-for-byte.

userStories.title: Deployment guard entry point
userStories.description: As an operator or a CI job, I want one command that pulls the published image, verifies it, boots it in the image-only flavor, and asserts resource and internal provisioning, so that the published artifact is validated the same way every time.
acceptanceCriteria: .oh/scripts/deployment-guard.sh exists, is executable, and resolves IMAGE from a positional argument else OH_SANDBOX_IMAGE else ghcr.io/mifunedev/openharness:latest
Preflight aborts before touching the daemon when docker or jq is absent, or when any existing container, volume, or network already matches the run's unique project name
It runs `docker pull` on the resolved image and then `bash .oh/scripts/verify-sandbox-image.sh` on it

It runs sandbox-boot-smoke.sh with BOOT_SMOKE_FLAVOR=image-only, BOOT_SMOKE_COMPOSE pointed at deployment-compose.sh, a unique SANDBOX_NAME, OH_PULL_POLICY=never, and a BOOT_SMOKE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS greater than the image-only healthcheck deadline derived from docker-compose.image-only.yml (start_period + interval x retries)
Post-boot assertions accumulate rather than fail fast, and each prints an ok:/FAIL: line naming the assertion
Assertion: docker logs contains `no checkout bind at` and does not contain `checkout bind detected at`
Assertion: /home/sandbox/harness/.oh/.image-seeded exists in the container
Assertion: the container's ~/.gitconfig carries the GIT_USER_NAME and GIT_USER_EMAIL the guard passed in

Assertion read from `docker inspect`, not from inside the container: exactly one mount, of type volume, destination /home/sandbox; no published ports; no /var/run/docker.sock bind; HostConfig.Privileged is false

Assertion of the persist-and-install contract: a catalog entry that is kind:"optional" and installed:false before the call becomes install.<id>==true in oh.json and a live binary under NPM_USER_PREFIX after `oh harness install`; the pre-state is asserted first so the check cannot pass vacuously
trap covers EXIT INT TERM; teardown removes only this run's own project resources, then asserts nothing matching the run name survives and forces a non-zero exit if anything leaked
The script text contains no `prune` verb and no bulk force-remove over a command substitution
shellcheck -S warning passes on the file
userStories.notes: Live run against :latest printed 32 ok: lines and exit 0. Negative run against :0.5.1 exit 1 with 6 named failures. Collision and SIGTERM tests both left the daemon byte-identical.

userStories.title: /deploy-check skill — the operator-facing door
userStories.description: As the operator, I want one skill that validates a deployment locally in a throwaway sandbox, so that I can check a feature end to end without polluting or touching my main harness sandbox.
acceptanceCriteria: .oh/skills/deploy-check/SKILL.md exists, authored through the /builder skill protocol, with name, description carrying explicit TRIGGER phrasing, and argument-hint frontmatter matching nearby skills such as health-check and ci-status
Argument shape `[scenario] [--image <ref>] [--local] [--keep]`, with `provisioning` as the default scenario; an unknown scenario prints the accepted list and stops without touching the daemon
The skill's procedure invokes `bash .oh/scripts/deployment-guard.sh` and re-implements none of its assertions and no second copy of the boot sequence

The skill states the isolation contract explicitly: unique compose project name, a volume created and destroyed with the run, its own DOCKER_CONFIG, no bind of the operator's checkout, no read or write of the checkout's oh.json or .env, no published port, no prune verb
The skill states that it never manages the operator's own sandbox and offers no way to attach to a long-lived one; it does not invoke `oh sandbox` or `oh shell`
`--keep` skips teardown and prints the exact cleanup command it did not run
The skill documents how a second scenario is added — a case branch in the runner plus its assertions — so the extension point is real rather than promised
`.claude/skills/deploy-check` resolves through the provider mirror and `bash .oh/scripts/link-providers.sh --check` exits 0
A PROPOSED record is appended to .oh/evals/decisions/skill-impact.md with the next SI-nnnn id, the single target artifact, and the motivating pattern slugs
Every path, command, and flag named in the skill body is verified to exist before the skill is reported done
userStories.notes: Skill mirrored through .claude/skills (symlink); link-providers --check exits 0; frontmatter and every named path/command/sibling-skill verified; SI-0004 appended to the skill-impact ledger.

userStories.title: Tier-A wiring probe, driven red before it is trusted
userStories.description: As the eval suite, I want a fast probe that guards the deployment guard's wiring and host-safety invariants so that the instrument cannot be silently deleted or made unsafe, without attempting the live boot the 30s probe cap forbids.
acceptanceCriteria: .oh/evals/probes/deployment-guard-ci.sh exists with `# tier: A`, a `# source:` naming issue #937, and a `# desc:` stating it guards the instrument's wiring and host-safety invariants, not the deployment itself
It asserts the workflow invokes `bash .oh/scripts/deployment-guard.sh` and declares both the post-release trigger and workflow_dispatch
It asserts .oh/skills/deploy-check/SKILL.md exists and invokes `bash .oh/scripts/deployment-guard.sh`, so the operator-facing door cannot drift from the mechanism
It asserts deployment-guard.sh invokes verify-sandbox-image.sh and sandbox-boot-smoke.sh and still passes BOOT_SMOKE_FLAVOR=image-only
It asserts deployment-guard.sh matches no docker prune verb and no bulk force-remove over a command substitution, and that it traps EXIT INT TERM
It asserts sandbox-boot-smoke.sh still calls verify_bind_ownership on the bind path, so the flavor switch cannot disable it everywhere
Every assertion pins a short wrap-safe fragment; whole-line pins use grep -qxF
It restates no assertion already owned by .oh/evals/probes/oh-image-only-deploy.sh
Its SKIPPED guard cannot fire in this repository; running it here yields PASS or REGRESSION, never exit 2
Each assertion has been driven to REGRESSION by fault injection and the injection reverted; evidence.md records which assertions were driven red
It completes in under 30s and adds a row to .oh/evals/RESULTS.md
shellcheck -S warning passes on the file
userStories.notes: 20/20 fault injections caught via DEPLOY_GUARD_PROBE_ROOT, baseline green on an unmodified copy; runs sub-second; RESULTS.md row added.

userStories.title: Post-release CI workflow
userStories.description: As the project, I want the guard to run automatically after every successful release and on demand, so that a broken published image is caught rather than discovered by a user.
acceptanceCriteria: .github/workflows/deployment-guard.yml exists with `workflow_run` on completion of the workflow named `Release`, gated on the workflow_run conclusion being success
It also declares workflow_dispatch with an `image` input defaulting to ghcr.io/mifunedev/openharness:latest
One job: permissions contents read, timeout-minutes 20, checkout, `bash .oh/scripts/link-providers.sh --init`, jq installed if absent, then `bash .oh/scripts/deployment-guard.sh`
The job fails loudly when Docker or the network is unavailable; it contains no conditional that turns a missing daemon into a skip
The file parses as YAML and actionlint reports no error
It does not push, log in to a registry, request packages write, or reference secrets beyond the default token
userStories.notes: Workflow parses; workflow_run on Release + workflow_dispatch; no push/login/packages:write. NOT yet fired — workflow_run only fires from the default branch, so first proof is the release after merge.

userStories.title: Retire the non-gating checklist from the deployment doc
userStories.description: As a reader of the deployment guide, I want the manual checklist replaced by the instrument that now performs it, so that one source of truth describes how Flavor B is verified.
acceptanceCriteria: The section titled `### Manual live-host smoke checklist (non-gating)` is gone from docs/deployment-prebuilt-image.md
The word `non-gating` no longer appears in the file
The replacement text names .oh/scripts/deployment-guard.sh and .github/workflows/deployment-guard.yml and states the default image and the OH_SANDBOX_IMAGE override
The sentence naming the boot-time defaults as `Claude Code, Codex, Pi` is corrected to point at the catalog as the source of truth rather than a hardcoded three
No other section of the file changes
userStories.notes: "non-gating" no longer appears in docs/deployment-prebuilt-image.md; the section now points at /deploy-check, the guard, and the workflow; the defaults sentence names the catalogs as the source of truth.

userStories.title: Live end-to-end verification on a real daemon
userStories.description: As the operator, I want the guard proven against the real published image on a daemon shared with production containers, so that its assertions and its cleanup are both demonstrated rather than assumed.
acceptanceCriteria: Container, volume, and network inventories captured before the run are byte-identical to the inventories captured after it
`bash .oh/scripts/deployment-guard.sh` against ghcr.io/mifunedev/openharness:latest exits 0, and every assertion printed an ok: line
The same run is driven through the /deploy-check skill, not only the bare script, and the operator's own sandbox container and its volumes are confirmed untouched
A discrimination test proves the oracle is not vacuous: the guard exits non-zero against an input that should fail it, and the failure names the assertion
An interrupt test: the run is killed mid-boot with SIGTERM and no resource matching the run name survives
A collision test: pointing the run name at an existing resource aborts in preflight with the daemon unmodified
`bash .oh/scripts/sandbox-boot-smoke.sh` with no BOOT_SMOKE_FLAVOR is confirmed to still take the verify_bind_ownership path (bind-flavor non-regression)
`bash .oh/skills/eval/run.sh` reports no green-to-red transition
userStories.notes: Full pass, discrimination, interrupt, and collision tests all run on a daemon with 13 pre-existing containers; every inventory byte-identical. Bind-flavor live non-regression is delegated to sandbox-boot-guard.yml on this PR (disclosed in evidence.md).

userStories.title: Knowledge impact
userStories.description: As the knowledge corpus, I want the pages this change contradicts brought back in line, so that a future planner reads what the repository actually does.
acceptanceCriteria: .oh/knowledge/source/compose-env-boundary.md records the second compose driver and the deployment guard as the consumer that boots the image-only flavor, with verified_at advanced
.oh/knowledge/source/sandbox-dependency-installs.md records that boot-time provisioning now has a published-image oracle, with verified_at advanced
Each updated page's claims are re-read against the current sources named in its `sources:` list before verified_at moves
.oh/knowledge/README.md is regenerated and `bash .oh/evals/probes/wiki-readme-index.sh` exits 0
`bash .oh/skills/wiki/scripts/knowledge-impact.sh` reports no page left NEEDS-REVIEW by this diff without being addressed
userStories.notes: knowledge-impact.sh reported no NEEDS-REVIEW; the Expected union resolved as compose-env-boundary UPDATED (verified_at advanced after re-reading cited claims), audit-architecture UPDATED (verified_at deliberately not advanced), sandbox-dependency-installs NOT-AFFECTED. wiki-readme-index PASS.
